description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate Divulapitiya D/S Division and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including detailed schedules with cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and registration details. It involves the legal process of claiming rights to land properties through the Registration of Title Act, falling squarely under land and property-related matters as defined for Type 4 classification.
